text.en:
The phrase "Less-forced savings from salaries and wages" appearing under subheading
"V-Summary" of the appropriation for the National Library as provided in Commonwealth Act Numbered
Two hundred and forty-five is hereby amended to read "Less-forced savings."

This Act shall take effect as of January first, nine-teen hundred and thirty-eight.
Approved, September 5, 1938.
